 By HERMES JOY TUNAC , GMA News Published November 1, 2026 11:29am 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: Starbucks Philippines Starbucks Philippines has unveiled its 2027 collectibles!
 The international coffee chain has expanded this year's collection to five items, up from four in 2026: a planner with pouch, a travel case with towel, a stainless-steel tumbler, a cold cup, and a glass mug.
 Here are more details about each item:
 The collection of stickers will begin on November 3 and will run until March 2027. Customers may earn a sticker for every purchase of a Tall, Grande, or Venti handcrafted beverage.
 For every 19 stickers, customers may receive one free product from the 2027 Starbucks "Traditions" collection. —MGP, GMA News
